author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Station Pilot — Scheduling Simulation (v0.2 vs v4)
abstract: Simulates weighted expected wait under baseline (v0.2 token-aware) vs v4 priorities using backlog-derived weights. Writes JSON/MD summaries.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.simulate_scheduler import *

# Run simulation with auto-detected baseline/compare and backlog-derived weights
# Functions imported via wildcard
files = _list_json()
base = _pick_baseline(files)
cmpf = _pick_compare(files, base) if base else None

if base is None or cmpf is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "Missing baseline or comparison file", "baseline": str(base) if base else None, "compare": str(cmpf) if cmpf else None}, indent=2))
else:
    # simulate_scheduler main block will execute when imported via __main__ pattern,
    # so we replicate core logic here directly:
    base_pri = load_priorities(base)
    cmp_pri  = load_priorities(cmpf)
    base_ranks = dict(rank_order(base_pri))
    cmp_ranks  = dict(rank_order(cmp_pri))
    weights = compute_weights_from_metrics()
    for a in set(list(base_pri.keys()) + list(cmp_pri.keys())):
        weights.setdefault(a, 1.0)

    base_wait = weighted_expected_wait(base_ranks, weights)
    cmp_wait  = weighted_expected_wait(cmp_ranks, weights)
    delta = None if (base_wait is None or cmp_wait is None) else (cmp_wait - base_wait)

    out = {
        "baseline_file": str(base),
        "compare_file": str(cmpf),
        "weights": weights,
        "baseline_expected_wait": base_wait,
        "compare_expected_wait": cmp_wait,
        "delta_wait": delta,
        "base_order": sorted(base_ranks.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]),
        "compare_order": sorted(cmp_ranks.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]),
    }

    # Write artifacts (reuse simulate_scheduler paths)
    from pathlib import Path
    DIR = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities")
    OUT_JSON = DIR / "AS_onboarding_v0_vs_v4_sim.json"
    OUT_MD = DIR / "AS_onboarding_v0_vs_v4_sim.md"
    DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    lines = []
    lines.append("# Adaptive Station Scheduling Simulation — Onboarding Pilot\n")
    lines.append(f"Baseline: {base}")
    lines.append(f"Compare:  {cmpf}\n")
    lines.append("## Orders\n")
    lines.append(f"- Baseline order: {', '.join(a for a,_ in sorted(base_ranks.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]))}")
    lines.append(f"- Compare order:  {', '.join(a for a,_ in sorted(cmp_ranks.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]))}\n")
    lines.append("## Weights (from backlog+1)\n")
    for a in sorted(weights.keys()):
        lines.append(f"- {a}: {weights[a]}")
    lines.append("\n## Expected Weighted Wait (lower is better)")
    lines.append(f"- Baseline: {base_wait}")
    lines.append(f"- Compare:  {cmp_wait}")
    lines.append(f"- Delta (compare - baseline): {delta}")
    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print(json.dumps({"artifact_json": str(OUT_JSON), "artifact_md": str(OUT_MD)}, indent=2))
